overview_description.description:
OpenUnit is an internet company that features a set of tools that gives storage operators the things they need such as online presence, reservation system, merchant solutions, and management software. It specializes in the fields of information technology, internet, and software platforms.

It was founded in 2019 and headquartered in Toronto, Ontario.

about_short_description.short_description: OpenUnit specializes in the fields of reservation system, merchant solutions, and management software.

product.name: OpenUnit Management Platform
product.description: A cloud-based software platform for managing self-storage facilities, including customer data, unit inventory, pricing, and operational analytics.

product.name: OpenUnit Payments
product.description: An integrated payment processing system for self-storage facilities supporting online and in-person payments with fixed transparent rates.

product.name: OpenUnit Point-of-Sale (POS) Software and Hardware
product.description: Point-of-sale software and pre-certified card readers for processing in-person payments at self-storage facilities.

product.name: OpenUnit Marketing and Website Management
product.description: Tools for creating and managing self-storage facility websites, online reservations, SEO, and digital marketing campaigns.

product.name: OpenUnit Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
product.description: A CRM system tailored for self-storage facilities to manage leads, customer profiles, messaging, and lease agreements.

identifier.value: OpenUnit Team Chat and Employee Management

product.name: OpenUnit Team Chat and Employee Management
product.description: A communication and task management tool for self-storage facility teams, including real-time chat, to-do lists, and role-based permissions.
